seoTitle: Content Signals Policy Builder for robots.txt
metaDescription: Generate Content-Signal lines (search, ai-input, ai-train) for robots.txt to say how crawlers may use your content. Free.
intro: Builds the Content-Signal line for robots.txt from your yes, no or not stated choices.
why:
Content signals are a convention from Cloudflare to say what you allow beyond crawling: building a search index, using content as input to AI answers, or training models. They sit in robots.txt as one line, such as Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-train=no.

Leaving a signal out states no preference, which is different from yes or no. The line only expresses a preference; nothing is blocked unless you add Disallow rules too.
howTo: Choose yes, no or not stated for each signal.
Add Disallow rules for crawlers you want to stop.

faq.a: No. It is a preference, not an access rule.

faq.q: What do the three signals mean?
faq.a: search: index and show links and short excerpts. ai-input: use in AI answers. ai-train: train models.
No preference, which is not the same as yes.
